prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: parking lot collision in Conroe, Texas. Injury: back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1347; do not mention it.)
text: I was backing my vehicle out of a space in the parking lot of a shopping center in Conroe, Texas, moving slowly with my mirrors checked. As I reversed, the rear bumper of my car made contact with the driver's side of a vehicle that was passing behind me. I stopped immediately and got out to look. Both vehicles had visible scuffs and a cracked tail light on my car, and the other driver and I exchanged insurance information before leaving the scene. The impact was low speed, but I felt a sharp pain in my lower back that evening and have since been diagnosed with a back strain. I am currently following my doctor's recommendations for rest and physical therapy, and I have kept copies of all medical visits and repair estimates for this claim.
